name: t1_primary
title: Primary hypotheses (Holm over H1, H1b, H2, H3, H4; §1.3 headline rule): Laya-Fin and the anchor
notes: Estimates in each hypothesis' direction (H2: min(b, −c)); p one-sided; the anchor's p is its own (§1.3), not Holm-adjusted. H2's CI is in t2 (b and c separately).
The anchor's direction, H2 and continuation readings are uninformative (NA-11 REPORT §7.1).

name: t1b_primary_by_model
title: H1–H4 for every decision model (the API models screen-failing and model-specific)
notes: Holm within each model is descriptive; only Laya-Fin's Holm enters the headline rule.

name: t2_h2_over_under
title: Over/under regression y = a + b·N̂ + c·G + day × tier FE by decision point and within |G| bins
notes: Two-way clustered (session, firm) SEs; Driscoll–Kraay (5 lags) SEs and p in the _dk columns.
D2: y2, G = z_cc,t, N̂ from Call A on W2; D1: y1, G at 10:00, N̂_W0; D0: y0 = z_id, no G.

name: t3_ic
title: Daily IC of N̂_W0 with z_cc, z_on and z_id, and quintile spreads (§11.1)

name: t4_secondary
title: Secondary hypotheses (BH, q = 0.10, within each instrument; pooled sensitivity family)
notes: H6 and A3.4 need tone and the explanation answer (Q16), which the trained models do not give.
The pooled family adds d1-ultra's H6 and A3.4 to Laya-Fin's six (PREREG §15 NA-12 row).

name: t5_heterogeneity
title: Heterogeneity cuts on H2 at D2: Wald test of N̂·1[cut] and G·1[cut], BH over each model's eight cuts
notes: Laya-Fin's eight cuts are the family; the anchor's and d1-ultra's are reported.

name: t6_convergence_ladder
title: A1 convergence ladder: κ_h of CAR^lvl_h on V (D0 events, day × tier FE) and the shares κ_h / κ_h*
notes: ladder_clean: each rung on its clean-window events; ladder_h10: h* = t+10; ladder_plateau: the mean CAR^lvl over t+16..t+20. The C_t+60 rung is exploratory.

name: t7_gap_closure
title: A1 gap closure AR(τ→h)/σ = a + λ_h·U_τ + ψ_h·V (+ FE) at D2 and D1; half-life (first λ_h >= 0.5)
notes: ψ carries its two-sided p (ψ_h* = 0, outside every family); a half-life of ∞ is beyond t+20.

name: t8_tracking_error
title: A1 tracking error RMSE(CAR^lvl_h − V) relative to the naive 0 and to the price-only V

name: t9_convergence_cuts
title: A1 by tier, quantified vs story (vendor; d1-ultra's own label) and |G| bin
notes: |G| bins apply to gap closure only (the D0 ladder has no G); PREREG §15 NA-12 row.

name: t10_explanation_ladder
title: A3.2 explanation ladder: out-of-sample share of stock-specific daily variance (z_cc) by step
notes: Ridge fit on val-B, λ on val-A, evaluated on test (§11.5); news features are 0 on days without an event.

name: t11_explanation_share_theta
title: A3.3–A3.5 (d1-ultra, model-specific): explained share, θ, persistence by reason, the market

name: t12_question_battery
title: A2.5: mechanism cuts (own labels and vendor tags), horizon validity, H4 width, reading validity

name: t13_shapley
title: §11.5 Shapley decomposition of the test OOS R² and mean daily IC over {R, N, J}, pooled and by tier

name: t14_model_comparison
title: Model comparison: daily IC of N̂_W0 with z_cc (val-B, test, common test events), cost, latency
notes: The API models are screen-failing and model-specific (§15 NA-06 row). span-02: the S5 canary fired a STOP and the operator chose to proceed (PREREG §15, post-freeze NA-11 row).
Costs per 1,000 decisions include answers paid by earlier chunks; the price-only D2 row is IC with y2.

name: t15_calibration
title: §11.2 calibration of Q1's three classes (ECE; log-loss and Brier skill vs val-A climatology); H7

name: t16_robustness
title: §11.6 and operator rows (a)–(b): every robustness variant, raw and placebo-adjusted
notes: At D0 each variant re-runs H1, H1b and the ICs; at D2, H2 (§15 NA-11 row (xii)).

name: t17_sector_exploratory
title: Exploratory (outside every family, no claim): IC of N̂_W0 by GICS sector and leave-one-sector-out

name: t18_probes_val_a
title: Disclosed val-A probes (NA-11; not hypotheses), next to the model comparison

name: t19_monthly_ic
title: Monthly mean daily IC of N̂_W0 with z_cc (val-A, val-B, test)
